tools.name: search_cards
tools.description: Find SlabLineage card pages by name, set or card number. Covers Pokémon and One Piece cards and PSA-graded sports slabs. Returns up to 12 cards, each with its card page URL and id.

tools.name: get_card_price
tools.description: The stored prices shown on a SlabLineage card page: the SL Consensus price and the PSA / TAG market prices across grades, with the same labels the page uses. Values are USD. The card page's raw (ungraded) price is returned separately as raw, or null when the page shows none.

tools.name: grade_math
tools.description: The SlabLineage grading calculator for a raw Pokémon or One Piece card: net result at PSA and TAG 9 and 10 after the grading fee, the recommended tier and a verdict. Uses the website's default selling fees (13.25% plus $0.40 per order, no shipping) unless you pass your own.

tools.name: get_guarantee_terms

tools.name: get_pregrade_info

tools.name: start_pregrade

tools.name: get_pregrade_result
tools.description: One of your pre-grades: the PSA and TAG grade ranges, whether it is guarantee eligible and why not, the report and upgrade deadlines, the claim status, and the upgrade link while the upgrade window is open.

tools.name: my_collection_summary
tools.description: Your SlabLineage collection in numbers: item count, total value at SL Consensus prices (condition-adjusted, times quantity), cost basis, and the change over a range, matching the app.

tools.name: search_my_collection
tools.description: Find cards in your SlabLineage collection by name, set or card number. Returns up to 25 items with quantity, condition and SL Consensus value.

tools.name: my_pregrades
tools.description: Your recent pre-grades with their grade ranges, status, report and upgrade deadlines, and any guarantee claim with its ship-by date.

tools.name: my_listings
tools.description: Your active marketplace listings connected to SlabLineage: listed price in USD, whether the listing was confirmed live and when, and your SlabLineage asking price. Read from SlabLineage's records, with no live marketplace call: no watchers, bids or price-vs-SL check (that is listing_checkup).

tools.name: my_sales

tools.name: my_price_alerts

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "undo_purchase" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_cards, record_purchase, record_trade, prepare_listing · Private data: my_listings, listing_checkup, record_purchase, log_sale, record_trade · Public sink: start_pregrade, prepare_listing, publish_listing.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_cards, record_purchase, record_trade, prepare_listing · Private data: my_listings, listing_checkup, record_purchase, log_sale, record_trade · Public sink: start_pregrade, prepare_listing, publish_listing

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
